title: WebhookEventDetails
description: Full details of a webhook event delivery including the request and response bodies, signature, and delivery metadata.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the webhook event.

name.description: Name associated with the document or entity.

url.description: Subscriber endpoint URL the event was delivered to.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the request body computed with the subscription shared key.

http_status_code.description: HTTP response status code from the subscriber.

delivery_time.description: Timestamp when the event was delivered.

event_time.description: Timestamp when the triggering event occurred.

request_body.description: JSON-serialized request body sent to the subscriber endpoint.

response_body.description: Response body received from the subscriber endpoint.

response_headers.description: Response headers received from the subscriber endpoint.
